pharmacology.text: It is structurally related to arylcyclohexylamines like MXE, 3-MeO-PCE, and deschloroketamine and is speculated to produce its effects through its activity as an NMDA receptor antagonist.

uses.text: 2-Oxo-PCE (also known as N-ethyldeschloroketamine, eticyclidone and O-PCE) is a dissociative anesthetic of the arylcyclohexylamine class that is closely related to deschloroketamine and eticyclidine, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 2-氧代-PCE，或N-ethyldeschloroketamine、eticyclidone、O-PCE，是一種芳基環己胺類解離麻醉劑，與去氯愷他命和乙環利定關係密切，曾被製成策劃藥於網上銷售。
summaryZhHans: 2-氧代-PCE，或N-ethyldeschloroketamine、eticyclidone、O-PCE，是一种芳基环己胺类解离麻醉剂，与去氯恺他命和乙环利定关系密切，曾被制成策划药于网上销售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dissociatives of its class can cause confusion, loss of coordination, nausea, raised blood pressure and a frightening sense of detachment. Heavy repeated use of related drugs has caused bladder and kidney damage, and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的解離劑類藥物可能造成意識混亂、協調能力喪失、噁心、血壓上升，以及令人恐懼的脫離感。反覆大量使用相關藥物曾造成膀胱與腎臟損傷，以及成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的解离剂类药物可能造成意识混乱、协调能力丧失、恶心、血压上升，以及令人恐惧的脱离感。反复大量使用相关药物曾造成膀胱与肾脏损伤，以及成瘾。

fact.en: It belongs to the arylcyclohexylamines, the family that began with phencyclidine in 1956 and later gave ketamine, which was designed to be shorter acting and less distressing.
fact.zh: 它屬於芳基環己胺類，這個家族始於 1956 年的苯環利定，後來衍生出氯胺酮；氯胺酮的設計目標是作用更短、較少引起不適。
fact.zhHans: 它属于芳基环己胺类，这个家族始于 1956 年的苯环利定，后来衍生出氯胺酮；氯胺酮的设计目标是作用更短、较少引起不适。
